course_name: Bachelor in Science (Economics and Business Administration)
duration: 3 years, 180 ECTS; Helsinki campus (the separate Swedish-taught Bachelor's is also offered at Vaasa, not this English-taught one, per its own page); single common admission — after mandatory first-year foundation courses, students choose 1 of 5 majors: Marketing, Accounting, Finance, Economics, or Management and Entrepreneurship (Finance major has additional entry requirements); majors are not separately admitted/coded; admission to this Bachelor's automatically includes the integrated pathway into Hanken's 2-year Master's without a separate Master's application; 25% early-commitment discount (to ~€9,000/yr) available if admission is accepted and paid within 21 days
